page.overview:
Who is Darth Ravi?

Darth Ravi, known as Darth Ravi the Bold, was a Force-sensitive Sith Lord considered ancient by the time of the High Republic Era. The Echo Stone was hidden from Darth Ravi on Angcord. Darth Ravi was a powerful Sith Lord in the dark side of the Force. He was a feared lightsaber duelist and was skilled in both Force lightning and telekinesis.

Darth Ravi was first mentioned in a flashback in the comic one-shot The High Republic Adventures: Quest of the Jedi, written by Claudia Gray and published by Dark Horse Comics Prior to the comic's release, an excerpt of the one-shot which included mention of Darth Ravi was released as part of an article on the official Star Wars website on April 9 of the same year.

Ravi later appeared for the first time in the first issue of the comic miniseries Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Echoes of Fear, written by George Mann, and illustrated by Eduardo Mello. the comic was officially released on September 4, 2024. However, it saw an accidental early release on August 21 of that year as its contents were featured in the digital edition of The High Republic Adventures (2023) 9.
